about_the_game:
Night Portable is a survival horror game that fuses retro gaming with immersive horror exploration.

After applying for a suspicious paranormal investigation job, you find yourself trapped inside a game shop at midnight. Waiting for you is a cursed handheld console and the monstrous entity it summons — Tsukino. To survive the six in-game hours, you must explore carefully, manage resources, and withstand fear itself.

◆ Features

  • 3D Exploration: Sneak through a dark shop, hiding in shadows and avoiding noise to evade Tsukino.

  • 2D Retro Minigames: Play block breaker, side-scroller, or shooter-style retro games. Clearing them grants batteries, items, or buffs — failure draws Tsukino closer.

  • Item & Risk Management: Batteries, keys, ofuda talismans — limited resources are the key to survival.

  • Layered Visuals: 2D: Retro handheld game style, 3D exploration: Retro polygon style, and hyper-realistic Tsukino visuals emphasize her alien presence.

  • Storytelling: Each night unveils fragments of Tsukino’s tragic past and the curse behind the handheld.

Hide, run, and play.

Can you survive until dawn?

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains horror elements, disturbing imagery, character death, 
and themes such as miscarriage and ritual sacrifice that may be unsettling to some players. 
There is no explicit sexual content or graphic gore.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: ntel Core i3 / Ryzen 3 equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible (e.g. GTX 750 Ti / Intel UHD 620)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / Ryzen 5 equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible (e.g. GTX 1060 / Radeon RX 580 / Steam Deck APU equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
